findings.claim: The implied-by-planned-files half of AC-553-2 is still dead on the production skip path: the compiler field is written empty, and task-graph validate/set-status never see live files.
findings.analysis: Round 1 HIGH was that impliedRiskFlags read delivery_graph.planned_files and nothing wrote that field. Round 2 added collectPlannedFiles and compileDeliveryGraph.planned_files, but the production compile path still cannot populate it. loadInput() for CLI flags never copies planned_files / files_planned / files; the documented route-workflow invocation (lane-model.md) passes only --wi/--lane/--change-type/--intent/--risk-flags/--out. compileDeliveryGraph therefore emits planned_files: [] unless a caller uses --input JSON or the JS API. The T2-compiler fixture only exercises that JS API with planned_files already in the argument object. validateDesignTechRiskGate now unions collectPlannedFiles with liveDiffFiles, but liveDiffFiles is uncommitted-only (git diff HEAD + cached) and still lives only on the prompt-invoked lane validator — the same non-mutation path round 1 rejected as insufficient. The path that actually skips, scripts/task-graph.mjs, inlines ac553PlannedFiles from graph.planned_files / delivery_graph.planned_files / delivery_graph.files and does not scan the worktree. So a WI-542-class bugfix still compiles with empty planned_files, set-status skips design-tech with 'no product UI' while flags are undeclared, then edits hooks/svc-session-start-healthcheck.mjs; task-graph validate and the lane-tasks hook still see no implied flags. Check 11 still does not scan the Files Planned table or the live diff. The mechanical backstop for a forgotten declaration still does not fire where the skip is applied.
findings.proposed_fix: Map --planned-files (and --input.planned_files) through loadInput so the documented compile command actually fills delivery_graph.planned_files. Have task-graph.mjs ac553PlannedFiles use the same graph fields plus liveDiffFiles as the lane validator (inline the helper; do not import risk-flags.mjs). Optionally feed plan-changeset Files Planned / origin/main...HEAD names into that set so implication survives after commit. Add a fixture: CLI compile without JS-API planned_files, then set-status skip design-tech while a matching hook path is dirty, expect AC-553-2 refuse.

findings.claim: The check-then-write mechanical check is still a narrow prose regex that dies at a period; the atomic_primitive allowlist remains the real gate.
findings.analysis: Not in the claimed round-2 remediations. CHECK_THEN_WRITE_RE is unchanged: check|exists?|stat, then then|before, then writ|creat, with [^.]{0,40} stopping at a period. 'Check if the file exists. Then write it.', 'if missing, create it', and 'write only when absent' still evade. A contract that names o_excl while describing a check-then-write race in concurrent_invoke_behavior can still pass. concurrency_test: 'none' still satisfies hasText.
findings.proposed_fix: Normalize concurrent_invoke_behavior (strip punctuation, collapse whitespace) before the regex; add an existence check that concurrency_test names a real file; keep the primitive allowlist as the hard gate.
